name: starforge
description: Pipeline canvas, checkpointing, and stale/hydrate execution for the repo you already have open.

starforge.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter for the *Forge kernel. Leave empty to use the ms-python extension's active interpreter, falling back to 'python'. The starforge-kernel package must be installed in this environment.

starforge.pickleEnabled.description: Allow the pickle serializer tier for checkpoint outputs that have no native serializer. When off, such outputs are ephemeral: they flow within a run but downstream nodes recompute in future runs.

enumDescriptions: Function body only — cheapest; edits to helpers are NOT detected (risk of stale-but-green results).
Function + its module — catches same-file helper edits; cross-module helpers are NOT detected.
Function + repo import closure (recommended) — any edit to an imported module marks dependents stale. Over-invalidates safely: extra reruns, never wrong data.
starforge.stalenessTier.description: How much surrounding code participates in staleness detection.

starforge.maxCheckpointSizeMB.description: Checkpoint store size budget per workspace. After each run, least-recently-used checkpoints are evicted until under this cap (evicted nodes simply read as stale and recompute).
